source.evidence: local UCLA_crop/map, Tx, pmap, dmap directory contract
source.evidence_boundary: 2D image-only package; fixed building and Tx heights are explicit proxies.

scene.coordinate_convention: PNG arrays use row/col; Tx centroid is converted to bottom-origin x,y
scene.building_height_source: fixed 2D proxy; no height raster supplied
scene.tx_height_audit_note: Tx mask has no z coordinate; configured Tx height is an explicit proxy

png_gray_mapping.method: linear gray/255 to signed target dB

dataset_labels.paper_quantity: signed target dB from local pmap

physics_prior.owr_cd_algorithm_name: OWR-CD (One-Way Recursive Corner Diffraction; canonical UTD wedge)
physics_prior.auto_selection_rule: Use OWR-CD when Tx/Rx heights are close and both are below half the maximum building height; otherwise use OWR-RD.
physics_prior.d1_d2_definition: 3D Euclidean distances using fixed-height proxy and 0.86 m/pixel

visualization.note: Fixed across selected samples; no per-image min-max normalization.
